svg.title: 3. Canary with automatic rollback
svg.text: Why the blast radius stayed small
Progressive delivery on EKS: a canary that rolls itself back
Argo Rollouts shifts ALB traffic by weight, checks CloudWatch and Prometheus at every step, and aborts to the stable version when the analysis fails. Git is reverted afterwards, not during.
About 25 minutes from first canary pod to 100%, longer if traffic is too low for the analysis to be meaningful.
A second failed measurement (failureLimit 1) aborts: weight goes back to 0% canary in one ALB update.
Argo CD webhook, sync starts, 2 canary pods scheduled
Rollout aborted: canary weight 0%, ALB 100% to stable
Rollouts notification to the team channel; no page
Cause found: new payment client timeout 300 ms vs 800 ms
git revert merged in prod overlay. Argo CD shows Synced + Healthy
Fix ships through dev and staging again; staging now
Errors seen by shoppers: about 0.3% of checkout
requests for 3 minutes. Without the canary: 3%+
of all checkouts until someone noticed.
- Only 10% of requests ever reached v42
- Rollback was an ALB weight change: no new pods, no pulls
- git revert made Git match reality (app was Degraded until then)
